title: EquipmentShare Named to the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™
summary: EquipmentShare earned its place on the list based on its continued revenue growth, which climbed 158.8% from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2025.
body_markdown:
**COLUMBIA, Mo. (Nov. 23, 2026)** — EquipmentShare.com Inc (Nasdaq: EQPT) (“EquipmentShare”), a leader in connected jobsite technology and one of the largest equipment rental providers in the United States, today announced that it was selected to the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ list, a ranking of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America that’s now in its 32nd year. EquipmentShare earned its place on the list based on its continued revenue growth, which climbed 158.8% from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2025.


"Being recognized on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ underscores a fundamental shift happening across construction: Contractors want technology that connects every moving piece on the jobsite,” said Jabbok Schlacks, Founder and Chief Executive Officer. “Our growth is a direct reflection of our team’s relentless commitment to solving real-world problems in the field and giving builders a single source of truth that keeps crews safer, projects moving faster and operations running more efficiently."


“The 2026 rankings demonstrate that established momentum and breakthrough growth can drive sustained market leadership,” said Justin Yahr, Audit & Assurance partner and National Emerging Growth Company leader, Deloitte & Touche LLP. “Nearly 70% of this year’s award winners returned as repeat honorees, reflecting the power of disciplined and sustained execution. More than 30% made the list for the first time, illustrating how quickly new players are shaping their respective sectors.


Building on that multiyear trajectory, EquipmentShare has delivered a transformative year of operational and financial milestones throughout 2026:


- Following its Nasdaq debut earlier this year, EquipmentShare recently reported total revenue of $1.468 billion for the third quarter of 2026, raised its full-year 2026 financial outlook and announced a $500 million share repurchase program.
- EquipmentShare grew its nationwide footprint from 385 locations at year-end 2025 to 448 locations across 45 states as of September 30, 2026, adding 63 locations in the first nine months of 2026, while scaling to 9,700+ employees and managing $10.7 billion in original equipment cost under management.
- This year, EquipmentShare announced a landmark multi-year agreement with Cummins Inc. (“Cummins”), under which it expects to deploy 1 gigawatt of natural gas power generation capacity to support major energy projects across the United States; was named as an official supplier of the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX 2026; broke ground on a major headquarters expansion in Columbia, Missouri to support its nationwide growth; and earned Overall Fleet Management Company of the Year honors in the 2026 AutoTech Breakthrough Awards.


**About the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500**


Now in its 32nd year, the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 provides a ranking of the fastest-growing tech companies — both public and private — in North America. Technology Fast 500 award winners are selected based on percentage fiscal year revenue growth from 2022 to 2025. In order to be eligible for Technology Fast 500 recognition, companies must own proprietary intellectual property or proprietary technology that significantly contributes to the company’s operating revenues. Companies must have base-year (fiscal year 2022) operating revenues of at least US$50,000, and current-year (fiscal year 2025) operating revenues of at least US$5 million, with a growth rate of 50% or greater. Additionally, companies must be in business for a minimum of four years and be headquartered within North America (United States and Canada).

**About EquipmentShare**


Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Columbia, Missouri, EquipmentShare (Nasdaq: EQPT) is a nationwide construction technology and equipment solutions provider dedicated to transforming the construction industry through innovative tools, platforms and data-driven insights. By empowering contractors, builders and equipment owners with its proprietary technology, *T3®* , EquipmentShare aims to drive productivity, efficiency, and collaboration across the construction sector. With a comprehensive suite of solutions that includes a fleet management platform, telematics devices and a best-in-class equipment rental marketplace, EquipmentShare continues to lead the industry in building the future of construction. For more information, visit[www.equipmentshare.com](http://www.equipmentshare.com/) .
